posts.meta_description:
6,769 likes, 408 comments - jayshetty on October 27, 2026: "Mikayla Nogueira is our latest ON Purpose Magazine cover star 🤍

Comment MIKAYLA to get the full piece sent straight to your inbox👇

This is a story about the person behind the makeup, the pressure of sharing your life with millions of people, and what happens when the life everyone sees online looks completely different from the one you’re living behind closed doors.

It’s about navigating addiction in a marriage, making the heartbreaking decision to walk away from someone you love, and finding the courage to start over when the future looks nothing like you imagined. It’s also about self-worth, the weight of public judgment, and learning that you can be confident in who you are while still struggling with how you see yourself.

Sometimes choosing yourself means letting go of the future you thought you were supposed to have.

And sometimes starting over is how you finally find yourself.".
